tips.scene: One beat of your video — a few seconds with its own image, video, and narration.
tips.still: The picture this scene starts from. Get this right before rendering video — stills are fast, video is slow.
tips.clip: The few seconds of video for this scene, animated from its still image.
tips.narration: What the voice says during this scene. Its length sets how long the scene runs.
tips.storyboard: All your still images in order — the plan for the video before any video is rendered.
tips.seed: Same prompt and seed give the same result. Change it for a different take.
tips.model: Use a different AI model for just this shot. Leave on Auto to use your default.
tips.motion: How the camera moves — plain words work: 'slow push in', 'orbit right', 'handheld', 'static'.
tips.length: How much source video to render. The narration still decides how long the scene plays.
tips.trim: Cut seconds off the start or end of this clip.
tips.overlay: Text drawn on screen during this scene.
tips.pin: Locks this exactly as it is. Regenerating and prompt edits skip it until you unpin.
tips.createFinal: Re-renders any draft scenes at full quality, then builds your MP4. Drafts are for deciding — do this when you're happy.
tips.duck: Automatically turns the music down whenever the narrator is speaking.
tips.beat: Nudges scene changes to land on the music's beat.
tips.captionsBurn: Captions are drawn onto the video itself. Always visible, works everywhere.
tips.captionsSidecar: Captions come as a subtitle file (.srt) viewers can turn on or off.
tips.proEditor: Sends your scenes, audio and timeline to a pro editor for manual finishing.
tips.voice: Which narrator speaks — a style like "deep male" or a Kokoro id. Empty uses the default.
tips.speed: 1.0 is normal. The scene re-times to match the new length.
tips.ownImage: The clip animates from your picture instead of the generated still.
tips.transition: How one scene flows into the next.
